text:
maya: Quick note — new Next + LlamaIndex sample (templates/next-llama-lite) failing for first-time runs. Steps and minimal logs below, thinking it's an SDK parity/auth wiring issue. anyone seen this?

lee: can you paste repro steps?

maya: Steps:
1) npx create-redwood-app --template next-llama-lite
2) yarn && cp .env.example .env.local (set REDWOOD_API_KEY and REDWOOD_API_URL)
3) open /eval in browser and click 'Run eval' -> UI spinner, server shows `401 GET /v1/model -> invalid_token`, browser SDK retries twice then throws.

frank: that smells like the starter still calls the client SDK directly for generation while the server issues ephemeral tokens. If the client doesn't attach the ephemeral token we get the 401 then retries.

maya: minimal console output: `fetch /api/auth/ephemeral -> 200 {expires_in:60}`, then immediately `POST /v1/generate 401`. So ephemeral endpoint is hit but not wired into the client call.

lee: common template bug — prefetch or HMR sometimes triggers the generation endpoint before the ephemeral flow completes. quick fix: ensure client awaits `/api/auth/ephemeral` and attaches `Authorization: Bearer <token>` before calling SDK. Also add a tiny backoff that retries once if you see 401 and ephemeral was just minted.

frank: I'll open a starter PR to update the client wiring and bump `@redwood/sdk-js` to include the browser parity patch. Will also add a unit test in the eval harness that simulates ephemeral issuance + generation call.

ci-bot: ci-bot: created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/issues/305 and added smoke test step to pre-warm `/api/auth/ephemeral` before running the eval.

docs-bot: docs-bot: created docs PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/235 — adds ephemeral auth snippet and troubleshooting: "If eval fails with 401 on first run, confirm ephemeral token flow and restart the page."

maya: great, thanks — will test the starter PR once it's up on a dev canary. will also add a short note in the sample README for first-time contributors. :thumbsup:
